messages.settings.invulnerable_help: A testing aid, not a difficulty mode. Turn it off before release.
messages.settings.revision_help: Increase this when exported content changes. Versions only move forward here.
messages.settings.closeups_help: Players begin here, then may override this in their own display settings.
